svg.title: Self-attention computes a score between every pair of tokens: quadratic cost
svg.desc: Three grids of increasing size, four by four, eight by eight, and sixteen by sixteen, each representing the pairwise attention score matrix for a sequence of that many tokens, illustrating that the number of score computations grows with the square of sequence length.
svg.text: Doubling the sequence length quadruples the number of pairwise attention scores that must be
computed: this is the direct source of prefill's quadratic compute cost.
